story_type: submarine breaks up through Arctic sea ice
hook: A submarine punched straight up through the Arctic ice.
narration: A submarine punched straight up through solid Arctic ice.
This is USS Connecticut, a Seawolf-class fast-attack submarine, surfacing in the Beaufort Sea north of Alaska.
Submarines built for the Arctic carry a hardened sail, the tall tower on top, so they can break up through the pack.
Then the crew climbed out of the hatch into the cold.
It was part of ICEX twenty eighteen, a five-week Navy exercise to test how ready it is to operate in the Arctic.
outcome: USS Connecticut surfaced through the ice of the Beaufort Sea on March twenty first, twenty eighteen.
title: Submarine breaks through Arctic ice
description:
The fast-attack submarine USS Connecticut (SSN 22) surfaces through the ice of the Beaufort Sea, Arctic Ocean, during Ice Exercise 2018 on March 21, 2018.
